name: WIPO Global Brand Database
coverage: Multiple national and international collections; WIPO recommends national registers as additional sources.

name: EUIPO Search IP / TMview
coverage: EU and participating national, regional, and international offices; not all jurisdictions.

name: USPTO Trademark Search
operator: United States Patent and Trademark Office

name: UK IPO Trade Marks Search
coverage: United Kingdom trademark records; includes Nice class filters.

name: Canadian Trademarks Database
coverage: Canadian trademark records, including active and many inactive marks.

name: Australian Trade Mark Search
coverage: Australian registered and pending trademark records.

name: Trade Mark Public Search
operator: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks, India
coverage: Indian trademark records; portal supports interactive search.

name: J-PlatPat Trademark Search
operator: National Center for Industrial Property Information and Training / Japan Patent Office
coverage: Japanese trademark information through the official J-PlatPat service.

name: INPI Brazil Search by Trademarks
operator: Brazilian National Institute of Industrial Property
coverage: Brazilian trademark records; search interface is Portuguese.

name: KIPRIS Trademark Search
operator: Korea Intellectual Property Rights Information Service
coverage: South Korean intellectual property records; use the trademark search and account for Korean-language variants.

name: IPOS Digital Hub Similar Mark Search
coverage: Singapore trademark search; access and workflow may require interactive portal steps.

name: CNIPA National IP Public Service Platform
coverage: Chinese trademark announcement and registration search services; Chinese-language search and manual review may be required.
